Gifted: Telepathy.name: Gifted: Telepathy
Gifted: Telepathy.description:
🧬 Telepathy, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you speak into the heads of up to five people within about a hundred meters, through walls, smoke and noise, and feel the minds near you, even under rubble.
📈 With training: stunning static, shared sight, a team linked mind to mind, the trapped kept calm, surface thoughts read, all hostile minds struck, a district addressed.
⚠️ It works one way: you hear no answers and read no thoughts until training opens surface reading.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as reaching into other minds wears down your own.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mandalay (Telepath).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Telepathy.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Telepathy family): Scale: the user speaks into minds. A new adult user reaches up to five people they can see or have met within about a hundred meters, a few sentences at a time, in their voice; walls, smoke, noise and deafness do not stop it. They also feel minds within about thirty meters: how many, where, awake or not. Images and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: one way at the start: no replies, no thoughts read. Cannot move a body, plant a command or change a feeling; a message can be ignored, not unheard; the unconscious receive nothing. Quirk Strain: light: messages, sensing minds; moderate: mental spike, shared sight, team link; heavy: rescue link, reading a mind; severe: signature strike, district-wide link. Type: Emitter. Law: messaging strangers' minds without cause is harassment; reading a mind without consent is a serious crime and spoils any evidence; licensed users read minds only to save lives.
